subject: castle-cliff-faces
label: Cliff and chasm library — the vertical surfaces CourtyardV2 needs, built as a reusable set
notes: THIS IS A LIBRARY, NOT A PATCH. Raheem, 2026-08-06: 'we need to create a folder of beautiful assets so we can build this world.' So this is ten pieces at double the resolution I first proposed, covering height variety, negative elevation, and the fantasy dressing — not the minimum that unblocks one map.

WHY THE IMAGE ROUTE, AND IT IS NOT ABOUT COST. /create-image-pixen is the endpoint that returns FLAT TILEABLE BANDS. The object route was tried first and returned isometric cubes — beautiful, unusable on flat ground. The tiles route with tile_feature 'building' returned 56 unusable 52x87 fragments, because a cliff face is a VERTICAL surface and the tiles endpoint is top-down. This route also accepts a seed, so anything good is reproducible and anything wrong is a targeted re-roll rather than a blind re-buy.

RESOLUTION: 256px wide, double the first proposal. Per playbook 'author at display resolution' — upscaling pixel art is fine, downscaling destroys it. At 32px tiles a 256-wide band spans 8 tiles, so the repeat is far less visible than a 128 band, and it can be resampled DOWN cleanly if we ever want it smaller.
THESE MUST TILE LEFT-TO-RIGHT. They repeat along the south edge of every raised mass. Seamlessness is stated in every description; a mismatched edge is a seeded re-roll, not a redesign.
SOUTH-FACING ONLY. Verified against Raheem's layout sketch: you only ever see the side of a hill on its south-facing edge. North edges butt into higher ground and are never drawn.
HEIGHT VARIETY IS FREE AT RUNTIME. Short band = one terrace. Tall band = a mountain. Stacking costs nothing, which is why the tall variant carries extra strata — so a stack does not read as a repeat.

NEGATIVE ELEVATION IS THE INVERSE GRADIENT. A cliff is lit at the top and shadowed under its lip. A chasm is lit at the top and goes to ABSOLUTE BLACK at the bottom with no visible floor — unreadable depth is the point, because it is what makes a player want to go and look.
COLOUR IS A POST-PROCESS. Greens get matched to the deepvivid ground ramp with lib/recolor.py --ramp after these land. Never re-roll for hue.
MODESTY RULE NOT APPLICABLE — no figures in this batch.

params.description: a seamlessly horizontally tileable cliff face seen from the SIDE, a band of stacked grey and honey sandstone rock strata with deep shadowed horizontal cracks, a lip of deep saturated green grass overhanging the very top edge, clumps of moss and small ferns growing from the ledges, darker toward the bottom, detailed pixel art, single colour black outline, basic shading

images.note: The distant mountain, bottom-left in the sketch. Extra strata so a stacked band does not read as a repeat.

params.description: a seamlessly horizontally tileable tall cliff face seen from the SIDE, a high wall of stacked grey and honey sandstone strata with many deep horizontal cracks and ledges, a lip of deep saturated green grass overhanging the very top edge, moss, small ferns and a few hardy shrubs rooted in the ledges, growing darker and cooler toward the bottom, detailed pixel art, single colour black outline, basic shading

images.note: Variety pass. A wall used three times in one map needs a second face or the eye finds the repeat.

images.note: The fantasy beat. Something magical in the rock, per the brief — a reason to walk the long way round.
